text: Course Overview: Control Science and Engineering is a discipline that studies the theories, methods, technologies, and engineering applications of control. It is based on cybernetics, systems theory, and information theory, and focuses on common issues in various application fields, that is, in order to achieve control goals, how to establish system models, analyze internal and environmental information, and adopt what control and decision-making behaviors. This discipline is called "Automation" at the undergraduate level and "Control Science and Engineering" at the graduate level.
